title: Collectible card swaying in perspective
summary: One portrait card on black leans into perspective to one side, holds, returns flat, then leans the other way and returns. Inner art layers slide against the frame, so a flat image reads as a thick object.
use_when: Showcasing a single collectible, pass, ticket or membership card
A loopable hero or social post for a digital item with one artwork
Giving a flat product shot depth without a 3D model
A calm, silent autoplay loop on a dark page

look.type_style: card: heavy condensed display word behind the subject (about 22 % of card height), bold grotesk title caps, small mono labels; frame footer: four tiny mono corner labels

sfx.event: card settles flat after each lean

structure.shot: single portrait card centred on black: metal-grey frame, dark artwork window with a bust and a big word behind it, title under it
structure.motion: card flat and frontal; nothing moves until 0.50 (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: card leans: left edge recedes, slight clockwise roll; the word behind the bust slides relative to the frame
structure.camera: locked; the card moves in place, frame size unchanged
structure.motion: lean in easings.inOutSine ~15 fr (0.50 to 1.00, ±0.25 s), card width -4 %; holds the lean 30 fr (1.00 to 2.00) with ~1° drift; inner layers parallax; overshoot not measurable

structure.shot: card returns to flat frontal and holds; frame highlight brightens as it faces the viewer
structure.camera: locked; the card moves in place, frame size unchanged
structure.motion: return easings.inOutSine ~15 fr (2.00 to 2.50, ±0.25 s), width back to 100 %; frontal hold 45 fr (2.50 to 4.00)

structure.shot: card leans the opposite way: right edge recedes, slight counter-clockwise roll; the word behind the bust slides the other way
structure.camera: locked; the card moves in place, frame size unchanged
structure.motion: mirror of row 2: lean easings.inOutSine ~15 fr (4.00 to 4.50, ±0.25 s), width -4 %; holds 30 fr (4.50 to 5.50); inner layers parallax

structure.shot: card back to flat frontal, identical to the first frame, holds until the loop point
structure.camera: locked; the card moves in place, frame size unchanged
structure.motion: return easings.inOutSine ~8-15 fr (5.50 to 6.00, ±0.25 s); frontal hold 30 fr (6.00 to 7.00) into the loop

params.brand: any brand.json: bg, fg, muted for the frame metal, mono for labels, display font for the card word
params.content.art: hero image for the artwork window (subject cut out on a transparent background works best)
params.content.backWord: one big word placed behind the subject, partly hidden by it
params.content.title: card title under the artwork, 2 words
params.content.sub: one small line under the title, about 10 words
params.content.serial: short id code top right of the card
params.content.price: small value label inside the artwork window
params.content.footer: 4 tiny corner labels along the frame bottom (mark, item name, edition, url)
params.timing.lean: frames for each lean and each return (default 15)
params.timing.hold: frames held in each lean (default 30) and flat (default 45)
params.tilt.yaw: degrees of lean (default ~18, mirrored on the second lean)

notes: No cuts; 7 s single shot split at the four tilt state changes (0.50, 2.27, 4.00, 5.77). Lean/return ~15 fr each at 0.25 s resolution, card width -4 % in the lean, flat holds 45 and 30 fr, lean holds 30 fr. Last frame equals first: seamless loop. Inner layers (back word, bust, labels) shift against the frame in the lean: proposed term layer-parallax-card. Frame brightness changes with angle: proposed term angle-sheen. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured (reference is silent).
